message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a public holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the adjacent Saturday or Sunday.  Where a holiday falls on a weekend, the *observed* day is shown.)

| # | Holiday | 2023 Date | Adjacent Weekend | Notes |
|---|---------|-----------|------------------|-------|
| 1 | **New Year’s Day** (Observed) | **Mon Jan 02** | Sat Dec 30 – Mon Jan 02 | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| 2 | **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | **Mon Feb 20** | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 | Third Monday of February. |
| 3 | **Good Friday** | **Fri Apr 07** | Fri Apr 07 – Sun Apr 09 | |
| 4 | **Victoria Day** | **Mon May 22** | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 | |
| 5 | **Canada Day** (Observed) | **Mon Jul 03** | Sat Jul 01 – Mon Jul 03 | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| 6 | **Labour Day** | **Mon Sep 04** | Sat Sep 02 – Mon Sep 04 | |
| 7 | **Thanksgiving** | **Mon Oct 09** | Sat Oct 07 – Mon Oct 09 | |
| 8 | **Remembrance Day** (Observed) | **Mon Nov 13** | Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13 | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| 9 | **Christmas Day** | **Mon Dec 25** | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 | |
|10 | **Boxing Day** | **Tue Dec 26** | — | Not a long weekend (falls on Tuesday). |

### Quick Take‑away
- **Total long weekends in 2023 (federal holidays): 10**  
- **Province‑specific holidays** (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland, etc.) may add additional long weekends depending on where you live.  
- If you need a province‑specific list, let me know which province(s) you’re interested in.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for scheduling your long‑weekend getaways!
